text_block_list.text:
While out shopping, as I walked through 
the shopping district—

I spotted Rice Shower watering plants at a 
flower shop.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho, heave-ho... ...Phew, I think 
that should do it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...H-Huh? What are you doing here... I 
mean, welcome...
choice_data_list: Why is Rice watching the shop?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The shopkeeper sprained her ankle because 
of a potted plant Rice knocked over...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That's why... Rice is going to help out 
today. I hope I can do a good job...
choice_data_list: Want a hand with the watering?
Shall I go put the flowers out on display?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh? R-Really...? ...Then, would you mind 
helping me...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
All the flowers in the shop... aren't they 
pretty? The roses especially are just 
wonderful...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
When you water them, the petals sparkle so 
brightly... Rice just can't help getting 
mesmerized.

I watered all the flowers in the shop 
while having a delightful chat with Rice 
Shower.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you... Some of them are heavy, 
so please be careful, okay...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Pretty flowers... If we decorate the shop 
front with lots of them, do you think 
customers will come? ...Ehehe!

I finished putting out all the stock. It 
turned out to be much heavier labor than 
I'd anticipated.
